dz: 在普伊萨耶战役(Battle of Fontenay-en-Puisaye)中,由查尔斯·鲍德和路易率领的德军击败了意大利洛泰一世和阿基塔内的佩平二世的军队.
de: In the Battle of Fontenay-en-Puisaye, forces led by Charles the Bald and Louis the German defeat the armies of Lothair I of Italy and Pepin II of Aquitaine.
